subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: Mount Olympus Home of Gods
description: A quick, practical guide to Mount Olympus Home of Gods.

hook.text: The Greek gods lived on Olympus—a real mountain in northern Greece, 9,573 feet tall. Divinity had an address.

buildup.text: The summit was always hidden in clouds. Greeks saw the clouds and imagined palaces, thrones, and feasts above.

discovery.text: Olympus served both as a real place and a mythic concept. The gods lived on the mountain and beyond it.

twist.text: When climbers finally reached the summit in 1913, they found no gods—just rock and wind. The myth moved elsewhere.

climax.text: Olympus shows that sacred mountains work best when unreachable. Climbing them dissolves the mystery.

punchline.text: Reach the top. The gods have left.

quiz.question: When was the summit of Mount Olympus first climbed?
